text:
marta: Nightly eval run run-20260222-03 flagged a spike in generation failures on the 'story-prompts' suite after the attn-kernel reordering change merged in PR #4123 (commit ab12cd3).
marta: Failing examples are short — model either truncates or repeats tokens (repeats like 'the the'), appears stochastic but reproducible in nightly. Link: https://ci.redwood-inference/evals/20260222/run-03
liam: Can you paste a minimal repro? Is this across quantized builds or only float32?
marta: Quick paste:
```
PROMPT: "Write a short bedtime story about a small red fox."
GOOD: "Once upon a time a small red fox..."
BAD: "Once upon a time the the the the..."
BAD2: (truncated mid-sentence) "...and fell as the moon"
```
marta: Observed on both q4_0 and fp32 nightly images, but q4 seems noisier.
juno-bot: nightly-eval-bot: story-prompts: failure-rate +7.8% vs last run. Regression start: 2026-02-21 22:10 UTC (aligned with merge of PR #4123).
nina: Assuming the attn reorder patch touched KV prefetch + sampling state flow. Can we run a deterministic seed locally to bisect?
liam: I ran a quick local with seed=42 and batch_size=4: repros with repeated tokens when batch>1, batch_size=1 looks okay. Suspect sampling_state not being copied properly during kernel reorder.
liam: Suspect code: in fused_attn.cu we moved prefetch earlier, but didn't clone rng/sampler state per micro-batch.
liam: Pseudocode:
```
// old
for mb in microbatches:
  prepare_kv(mb)
  run_attn(mb)
  sample(mb)
// new (reordered)
prepare_all_kv()
run_attn_all()
for mb in microbatches:
  sample(mb) // sampling_state may be shared accidentally
```
marta: Repro command I used: `./tools/run_eval --suite story-prompts --image nightly:20260222 --seed 42 --batch 4 --log-level debug`
ops-bot: deploy-bot: PR #4123 deployed to staging on 2026-02-21T22:08:11Z (image: nightly:20260221-4123).
nina: Plan: liam to bisect exact commit range, run with `--deterministic-sampling` and with old kernel (pre-4123). If confirmed, we either hotfix revert or patch sampling_state copying.
liam: I'll run a 50-sample bisect now and post results in ~45m.
marta: If bisect confirms, please also run a quick experiment: force serial sampling (no parallel microbatch sampling) as a short-term mitigation.
liam: noted. I'll also try instrumenting the kernel to dump per-microbatch rng_state hash.
ops-bot: incident-tracker: created incident IR-2026-029 (severity: S2) for eval regression, assigned to eng-runtime.
marta: Thanks — assigning myself to follow the revert if needed. Please ping #eng-ml if we need model-side fallbacks.
juno-bot: nightly-eval-bot: re-run scheduled with seed=42 after bisect results.
liam: Update: bisect points to commit ab12cd3..cd34ef6 (the chunk that moved prefetch). I'll open a PR with a minimal fix to copy sampling_state per microbatch and a test.
marta: Great. Once we have the PR, let's land to canary image and run the full suite.
liam: PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4189 - includes unit test and micro-batch rng hash check.
marta: Sounds good, thanks everyone.
liam: Will follow up with test artifacts and logs.
marta: Marking this thread resolved for now, moving to the post-bisect channel when fix lands.
